title: Give
subtitle: 本課限定語境：give = transfer something to someone, make something available, or cause someone to
description: 本課限定語境：give = transfer something to someone, make something available, or cause someone to receive something · 「給予／提供／交給」

words.note: 表示主動提出把某物、幫助、機會等給別人，但對方可以接受或拒絕。

exercises.original: She gave me a seat when she saw that I was tired.
exercises.zh: 她看到我很累，便主動讓座給我。
exercises.upgrade: She offered me a seat when she saw that I was tired.

options.explanation: 可表示提供座位，但較制度化，也沒有「主動提出」的語感。
讓座時先提出給對方，是典型用法。
通常是實體物件／控制權，不自然形容 seat。

exercises.original: The company gave employees the option of working from home.
exercises.zh: 公司向員工提供在家工作的選擇。
exercises.upgrade: The company offered employees the option of working from home.

options.explanation: 若表示正式批准某權利可用，但 offer an option 更自然。
可以 provide an option，但較少突出員工可接受或不接受。
選項本身就是被提出供選擇。

exercises.original: He gave to help me carry the boxes.
exercises.zh: 他主動提出幫我搬箱子。
exercises.upgrade: He offered to help me carry the boxes.

options.explanation: offer to do something 是標準結構。

words.note: 表示把某人需要的物品、服務、資訊或資源提供給他。
words.example: The school provides students with free materials.
words.exampleZh: 學校為學生提供免費教材。

exercises.original: The school gives students free learning materials.
exercises.zh: 學校為學生提供免費教材。
exercises.upgrade: The school provides students with free learning materials.

options.explanation: 也可，但可能只是提出可取得，未必突出制度性供應。
也很接近，更強調物資供應。
學校正式提供資源，是最中性自然的選擇。

exercises.original: The website gives users detailed instructions.
exercises.zh: 網站向使用者提供詳細說明。
exercises.upgrade: The website provides users with detailed instructions.

options.explanation: 可說 delivers information/content，但不如 provide 中性。
更像「呈現」資訊，不一定是提供資源。
information/instructions 是典型 provide 搭配。
需要較具體的轉交動作。

exercises.original: The service gives customers access to online support.
exercises.zh: 這項服務為顧客提供網上支援的使用權。
exercises.upgrade: The service provides customers with access to online support.

options.explanation: grant access 也很自然，但較正式，常暗示正式權限。
一般服務提供 access 很自然。
也可以，強調有這項服務可選。

words.note: 表示把物件、文件、金錢或控制權實際交給另一個人。
words.example: He handed over the keys to the new tenant.

exercises.original: He gave the keys to the new tenant.
exercises.zh: 他把鑰匙交給新租客。
exercises.upgrade: He handed over the keys to the new tenant.

options.explanation: 也可表示遞給，但較口語、短距離。
明確表示把鑰匙交到新租客控制下。
不適合一次性轉交鑰匙。

exercises.original: The employee gave the documents to the manager before leaving.
exercises.zh: 員工離開前把文件交給經理。
exercises.upgrade: The employee handed over the documents to the manager before leaving.

options.explanation: 如果重點是把文件送到指定目的地也可。
表示正式／實際移交文件，最自然。
只是提出給，不表示已完成轉交。

exercises.original: The owner gave control of the business to her daughter.
exercises.zh: 老闆把企業控制權移交給女兒。
exercises.upgrade: The owner handed over control of the business to her daughter.

options.explanation: 可以說 passed control to...，但 hand over 更明確表示正式移交。
可給權利，但不如 hand over 強調控制權轉移。
business control 是典型移交語境。

words.note: 表示正式地把禮物、獎項、證書或某物交給某人。
words.example: The mayor presented the winner with a medal.
words.exampleZh: 市長向得獎者頒發獎牌。

exercises.original: The mayor gave the winner a medal.
exercises.zh: 市長向得獎者頒發獎牌。
exercises.upgrade: The mayor presented the winner with a medal.

options.explanation: 也可，但通常是 awarded the winner a medal/prize，強調官方授予。
頒獎典禮中正式把獎牌交給得主，非常自然。
只描述遞交動作，缺少儀式感。

exercises.original: The school gave each graduate a certificate on stage.
exercises.zh: 學校在台上向每位畢業生頒發證書。
exercises.upgrade: The school presented each graduate with a certificate on stage.

options.explanation: 太日常，沒有正式儀式感。
on stage + certificate 是正式頒發的典型語境。
可表示提供證書，但不突出典禮。

exercises.original: They gave her a gift to thank her for her service.
exercises.zh: 他們送她一份禮物，以感謝她的服務。
exercises.upgrade: They presented her with a gift to thank her for her service.

options.explanation: 捐贈通常給機構／公共用途，不合個人致謝禮物。
只是提出送給她，不一定完成。
正式贈禮、致謝語境很自然。

words.note: 表示持續或系統性地提供所需物品、材料或資源。
words.example: The company supplies hospitals with medical equipment.
words.exampleZh: 公司向醫院供應醫療設備。

exercises.original: The company gives hospitals medical equipment every month.
exercises.zh: 公司每月向醫院供應醫療設備。
exercises.upgrade: The company supplies hospitals with medical equipment every month.

options.explanation: 也很自然，但 supply 更突出定期、大量物資。
每月供應設備，是典型物流／供應關係。
強調運送，不一定表示供應責任。

exercises.original: The farm gives local restaurants fresh vegetables.
exercises.zh: 農場向本地餐廳供應新鮮蔬菜。
exercises.upgrade: The farm supplies local restaurants with fresh vegetables.

options.explanation: 如果重點是每天運送到餐廳可用，但不一定表示長期供應關係。
表示有蔬菜可提供，未必實際供貨。
商業上持續提供產品，最自然。

exercises.original: The generator gives electricity to several buildings.
exercises.zh: 發電機向數棟建築供應電力。
exercises.upgrade: The generator supplies electricity to several buildings.

options.explanation: electricity / water / fuel 都是典型 supply 搭配。

words.note: 表示把物品、文件、訊息等送到某人或某地。
words.example: The courier delivered the package to the office.
words.exampleZh: 速遞員把包裹送到辦公室。

exercises.original: The courier gave the package to the office this morning.
exercises.zh: 速遞員今早把包裹送到辦公室。
exercises.upgrade: The courier delivered the package to the office this morning.

options.explanation: courier + package + destination 是典型 delivery 語境。
若強調實際交給某人可用，但缺少運送過程。

exercises.original: The company gave the replacement parts to the customer within two days.
exercises.zh: 公司在兩天內把替換零件送交顧客。
exercises.upgrade: The company delivered the replacement parts to the customer within two days.

options.explanation: 也可，但更強調供應來源。
within two days 強調送達時間。

exercises.original: The receptionist gave the message to the director as soon as she arrived.
exercises.zh: 接待員在主管一到達便把訊息傳達給她。
exercises.upgrade: The receptionist delivered the message to the director as soon as she arrived.

options.explanation: 像正式呈交，不如 deliver message 自然。
deliver a message 是固定自然搭配。

words.note: 表示正式給予權利、許可、請求、資助或某種資格。
words.example: The university granted her permission to defer the exam.

exercises.original: The university gave her permission to postpone the exam.
exercises.zh: 大學批准她延期考試。
exercises.upgrade: The university granted her permission to postpone the exam.

options.explanation: permission 通常不是「提出給」，而是正式批准。
可提供資訊／服務，但不自然說 provide permission。
grant permission 是標準正式搭配。
用於獎項／榮譽，不是 permission。

exercises.original: The system gives approved users access to confidential files.
exercises.zh: 系統向獲批准使用者授予機密檔案的存取權。
exercises.upgrade: The system grants approved users access to confidential files.

options.explanation: 也可以 provides access，較一般。
只是提供選項，不一定有權限批准意味。

exercises.original: The organization gave the research team additional funding.
exercises.zh: 該機構向研究團隊批出額外資助。
exercises.upgrade: The organization granted the research team additional funding.

options.explanation: 如果是慈善／無償捐款可用，但 research funding 常是正式批出。
正式批准 funding 是標準用法。
只表示送達資金／文件，不表示批准。

words.note: 表示經正式決定後，給予某人獎項、榮譽、金錢或合約。
words.example: The committee awarded her first prize.
words.exampleZh: 委員會把一等獎頒給她。

exercises.original: The judges gave her first prize.
exercises.zh: 評判把一等獎頒給她。
exercises.upgrade: The judges awarded her first prize.

options.explanation: 可說 presented her with the prize，強調頒發動作。
評判正式決定獎項歸屬，是最精確。
只是提出給，不是正式評選結果。

exercises.original: The court gave the claimant compensation.
exercises.zh: 法院判給申索人賠償。
exercises.upgrade: The court awarded the claimant compensation.

options.explanation: 不能表達法院正式裁定。
法律上 award damages/compensation 是標準搭配。

exercises.original: The committee gave the contract to the highest-scoring bidder.
exercises.zh: 委員會把合約授予評分最高的投標者。
exercises.upgrade: The committee awarded the contract to the highest-scoring bidder.

options.explanation: 可給權利／許可，但政府／商業合約通常用 award a contract。
可能只是提出合約，未必是正式評選結果。
經評審後授予合約，是標準搭配。
只表示實體或控制權移交。

words.note: 表示無償把金錢、物品或其他資源給慈善機構、公共用途或有需要的人。
words.example: They donated books to the local library.
words.exampleZh: 他們把書捐給本地圖書館。

exercises.original: They gave several boxes of books to the local library.
exercises.zh: 他們把數箱書捐給本地圖書館。
exercises.upgrade: They donated several boxes of books to the local library.

options.explanation: 如果是商業／持續供應可用，但本句是無償捐贈。
只描述轉交，不表達捐贈目的。

exercises.original: She gave part of her salary to a charity.
exercises.zh: 她把部分薪金捐給慈善機構。
exercises.upgrade: She donated part of her salary to a charity.

options.explanation: 通常是機構正式批出資助。
個人無償給慈善機構金錢，最自然。

exercises.original: The company gave unused computers to community groups.
exercises.zh: 公司把未使用的電腦捐給社區團體。
exercises.upgrade: The company donated unused computers to community groups.

options.explanation: 可形容正式贈送，但沒有慈善／公共用途意味那麼清楚。
企業把物資無償給社區團體，最自然。
只表示送到，不表示所有權無償轉移。

words.note: 較口語，表示把身邊的物件遞給另一個人。
words.example: Could you pass me the salt?

exercises.original: Could you give me the salt?
exercises.zh: 你可以把鹽遞給我嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Could you pass me the salt?

options.explanation: 餐桌上短距離遞物是典型用法。

exercises.original: She gave the document to the person sitting next to her.
exercises.zh: 她把文件遞給坐在旁邊的人。
exercises.upgrade: She passed the document to the person sitting next to her.

options.explanation: 也可，但較有正式移交意味。
坐在旁邊＋實體文件，短距離遞交最自然。

exercises.original: He gave the microphone to the next speaker.
exercises.zh: 他把咪高峰遞給下一位講者。
exercises.upgrade: He passed the microphone to the next speaker.

options.explanation: 把手邊物件遞給下一個人，最自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 借出 ≠ 給予 lend 表示之後要歸還。 她把書借給我。
出售 ≠ 給予 sell 涉及付款交換。
寄送 ≠ 所有 give send 強調把某物傳送出去；未必表示對方最終取得所有權。
展示 ≠ 給予 show 是讓別人看，不一定把東西交給對方。
告訴 ≠ 所有 give give information 有時可改為 tell someone something，但句法與範圍不同。
接收 ≠ 給予 receive 是 give 的方向相反。
詞形與用法不同 - give = 動詞 - gift = 名詞；也可作動詞，但不是所有語境都自然 - given = 過去分詞
詞形不同 - offer = 動詞／名詞 - offering = 提供之物／供品／現在分詞 - offered = 過去式／過去分詞
